title: Rotokakahi A3B1B1B — list of owners as at 14 Aug 1940 (Matiu Wiripo and three Rihari Matiu children) with schedule of ownership orders 1969–1990
summary: Nine pages (area 57:3:36 = 23.4363 ha; 63.636 shares). The 1940 list has just four owners: MATIU WIRIPO 36.363 (4/7) and Rirena Arama @ Rirena Rihari Matiu, "Tame Rihari Matiu @ Manuera Rihari Matiu" and Whina Rihari Matiu, 9.091 each (1/7) — the block came down through Matiu Wiripo, with Rihari Matiu's three children already holding their father's share. Then: (a) 4 Nov 1969 Rirena vested her 9.091 in her sons Makura (4.546) and Charlie Arama (4.545); (b) 3 Mar 1970 Matiu Wiripo's 36.363 was divided among his lines (S.V.O., KT 6/32-13): Wiremu Matiu and Reta Waipouri (2.577 each), the seven "Te Okena Matiu" children (Topia, Takuira, Pataraki or Pataraki Atama, Manuera, Iwa, Mane…), Te Okena and Hone Piriparaihe (Ruhia's line), the four Rihari Matiu children Rirena, Rata, Hira and HARE (1.299 each), the Maihi/Rurawhe line, the Wikitaringi Taitimu line, the Hapakuku, Wharewaka and Wi Hone lines; (c) 9 Nov 1970 WHINA's 9.091 went solely to "Rirena Rihari Matiu or Rirena Arama of Pawarenga" (KT 6/315); (d) 20 Oct 1981 Rirena's 10.390 to her EIGHT children — Lucy Nicholas, Michael, Makura, Graham, Andrew, Ken Arama, Hannah Wano and Charlie Arama, 1.299 each; (e) 1990 Makura's share to Michael Arama and Charlie's to Hannah Wano. Also Arapeta Peri Paraihe (list 15, 1.731) to the Public Trustee, 1982. The 1970 succession is the Court's own statement that the Te Okena (Atama) Matiu children, Ruhia's Piriparaihe sons and Rihari Matiu's children were all Matiu Wiripo's descendants.

title: Rotokakahi A — succession register 1889–1896: Wiremu Paraihe and Mereana Paraihe to Peri Paraihe, Hira Amuketi and Mereana Pirini (16 Mar 1896)
summary: Four register pages for the parent block Rotokakahi A, successions 1889–1896. Page 3 carries the earliest Paraihe record in this collection: WIREMU PARAIHE (d. 19 Dec 1891) and MEREANA PARAIHE, each succeeded on 16 March 1896 by Peri Paraihe (m), Hira Amuketi (f) and Mereana Pirini (f), one third each — the same three who took Hone Paraihe's Whakakoro F4 interest in 1914 (Hira by then dead and represented by her Amuketi children). This confirms Hira Amuketi as Peri Paraihe's sister and adds two more Paraihe (Wiremu and Mereana) who died before 1896 and whose relationship — sibling or parent — the register does not state. Also the Tipene (Hone Tana Papahia), Rikihana, Paraone, Hokopu and other families of Rotokakahi A.

title: Rotokakahi A3B1B1B — succession order schedule: Peri Paraihe (1936), Ria Hone Wharewaka (1940) and the exchange orders of 14 Aug 1940 consolidating Peri Paraihe's interest in Rirena, Tame and Whina Rihari Matiu
summary: Form 16 schedule for Rotokakahi A3B1B1B. (1) Peri Paraihe alias Kaperiere Paraihe (d. 1929): the same nine-way succession of 25 Sep 1936 as in Whakakoro F4 and Oturu A, with Rirena Arama trustee for Whina and Ria Hone Wharewaka trustee for the Okena Peri children. (2) Ria Hone Wharewaka (d. by 1940): her fifth to Wati Ratahi Topia, Erina, Rauriti, Ani and Ihaka Hone Wharewaka. (3) Two EXCHANGE ORDERS of 14 Aug 1940 (HK 17/294-5 and 296-7) by which Arapeta and Hone Peri Paraihe, the three Okena Peri children and Ria's five successors all gave up their Rotokakahi A3B1B1B shares to Rirena, Tame (Manuera) and Whina Rihari Matiu — so that by the 14 Aug 1940 list (doc 1279339) Rihari Matiu's three children held the whole of Peri Paraihe's 3/7 of the block (9.091 each) beside Matiu Wiripo's 4/7. This is the mechanism by which the Rihari Matiu line consolidated Peri Paraihe's Rotokakahi interest — and, presumably, gave up shares elsewhere in return.

summary: Page 1: typed list of the 31 owners of Paihia 1D1E2 (area 19:2:27 = 7.9596 ha; 216.666 shares; file no. 9294), with later strike-throughs pointing to successor list numbers. The six equal 5.317/5.318 shares (Arapeta, Hone, Te Okena; Hira, Rata, Rirena) total 31.905 — consistent with one earlier interest divided in two (Ruhia Matiu Wiripo's three sons; Rihari Matiu's three children), i.e. an interest that came down from Matiu Wiripo through both a daughter (Ruhia) and a son (Rihari). The Atama/Manihera owners are the Atama Matiu line (Wati Manihera absorbing five interests 1981–82).

title: Paihia 1D1C — succession order schedule 1929–1950 (7 pages): Ruhia Peri Matiu and the Peri Matiu children
summary: Seven pages of Form 16 succession order schedules for Paihia 1D1C. Key whānau entries (p.1, all 3 July 1929, HK 10/94): three children who died young — "Roi Matiu" (1906), "Hoana Peri Matiu" (1907) and "Hana Peri Matiu" (1909) — succeeded by "Ruhia Peri Matiu, f.a." solely (Hana's half shared with Iri Tamaho Maika). summary: Twenty-five pages: the alphabetical MLC 118A schedule of the owners of Parengarenga B3 (c. 1970, list numbers 1–229 with hand-written renumbering to c. 235 and later amendments), followed by a later re-typed list with different share figures (e.g. Mori Manuera Waata 476.20, Ngapera Teri Wi 147.24) and "Su 84–93" annotations. Pages 1, 2, 5, 6, 7 and the "R" page have been read for the whānau names: the Waipouri family — Aterea Waipouri (12, 1.688; "Erana Aterea Waipouri" 32, 6.733), Hera Waipouri (58), Kaperiera Waipouri (83, 2.110), Manuera Waipouri (105, 1.688), Matuku Waipouri (120, 2.110); the Matiu family — Kaperiera Matiu (84, 6.733), Manuera Matiu (103, 6.733), Merata Matiu (125, 6.733), Mikahere Matiu (136, 6.734), Joyce Elaine Tia Matiu alias Mrs J. Baker (81, 175.688); Matiu Pereeme (119, 40.637); Mere Kingi or Mrs Kingi Dudley (128, 11.826). Rihari Matiu himself is not on the list under R.

notes: Rihari Matiu (T009, d. 1949) appears on the Parengarenga B3A title of 1973 (NA55A/1289, 4.417 shares) but not on this B3 list. Kaperiera, Manuera, Merata and Mikahere Matiu hold equal 6.733 shares — four co-heirs of one Matiu; whether they are Rihari Matiu's children by a later marriage ("Rihari remarried several times"), with Manuera = Tame/Manuera Rihari Matiu (T025), is an open question logged in the discrepancy register. The Waipouri names sit beside Reta Waipouri (T142) and Annie Theresa Waipouri (T124) in the Rotokakahi/Paihia/Taupo records. Remaining pages (3–4, 8–9, 13–25) not yet transcribed.
